boundaries: Browser rendering, controls, responsive inspection and browser downloads remain unverified. The latest actual permission retry during Feature79 preparation targeted an origin serving Feature78 and was rejected before navigation. This recipe performs zero browser actions and no workaround.

The two temporal catalogue mappings record availability only. Connector reconciliation changes only its existing availability label and meaning, with all nine selectors, strict statuses and all prior delivered entries preserved. Frozen Feature60 historical71/15 figures are not rewritten. Full catalogue scope and all228 strict incomplete units remain.

NativeFloat64 semantic values and signed zero are retained. Raw NaN payload/sign/signalling bits, original decimal lexemes after native parsing and process-local scalar alias identity remain separate gates.

Raw text parsing receives exact bytes and length, including NUL/invalid UTF8. text_input_json is canonical NativeString storage, not implicitly a parser document. Native text output bytes and canonical complete stored results are separate; the moment parser reconstructs count=1, while full profile handoffs retain actual stored counts.

Find observes the actual native pointer offset/nullness and copies the entry within its owning profile lifetime. No process address, cross-request pointer lifetime, second find or fabricated lookup is exposed.

Finite lazy backing constructors, actual static getter snapshots and native scan callbacks are separate. Inspection does not add a scan. Literal business-hour flags, primary/alias timestamp selectors and negative/nonfinite zeta are passed without host cleanup or artificial range validation.

Flat and nested client-derived deviation Files are exact selected raw result fragments, bound to actual response SHA, bucket/index and fragment SHA. They are distinct from the18 native artifact slots and introduce no hidden HTTP or native call.

The first actual native build stopped during the new test-driver compile after successful core/server work. The accepted driver-only correction retains that successful prefix and historical failed proof; no old suite, core or server rebuild is mislabeled as a single combined passing run.

The first strict UI attempt found two unused test imports. The next focused run preserved166 passes and one failing synthetic -0 holder test. Its source-bound test correction preserves exact -0 in original holders; corrected actual strict/focused proofs are separately bound. Product UI logic was unchanged by both test-only corrections.

Baseline1 was deliberately superseded for a confirmed quadratic path-normalization implementation defect, with root stop/observation history retained. Baseline2 completed the same comparisons. This is not a timeout or a native build/test failure.

Independent original timing/EventLog time analysis and the previously audited older shared table-metadata carrier issue remain follow-ons. This temporal workspace does not silently repair those older surfaces. Browser, performance, concurrency and all strict reference gates remain separate.

Open host transport edge, observed in source only: named single-source operations treat an explicitly empty source_kind as an omitted selector and infer their declared source. The frozen protocol requires every explicitly supplied selector to match that source. Normal UI requests send a matching nonempty selector; this edge has not been runtime-probed and remains a follow-on, not a passing strict-contract claim.

The original API capture retained two false checks caused by integer -1 expectations for native double -1.0 outputs. Only those two typed expectations were amended; saved bytes were revalidated without any additional HTTP calls. Original requests, responses and failures remain bound in api_attempt_lineage.
